what: prereg05 exploration B2 (opp_cells_v2): finer opponent-move cells (line position, approximate own-group liberties after the move). Variant list fixed BEFORE any counting or scoring; no variant is added afterwards.
design_stage_only: inner pseudo-questions of training players only; not validation results; data/local is never opened; score.py is never run

subsample.players: the 5,767 fit players of data/prereg04/design_scratch/moves_fit.npz (split v1 fit)
subsample.rule: within each level, sort the level's fit players by sha256('c10-p05-b2|' + player_id) (hex, ascending) and keep the first ceil(25 % of the level's players); all their fit games
subsample.list_sha256_definition: sha256 of the UTF-8 bytes of '\n'.join(sorted(selected player_id))
subsample.fallback: if the 25 % count run exceeds 55 minutes it is stopped and rerun on 12.5 % (same rule with ceil(12.5 %)); written in the report

inputs.fit_moves: data/prereg04/design_scratch/moves_fit.npz (off, player_id, color, label) + moves_fit_moves.npy (SHA-256 equal to results/prereg04/design/scratch_manifest.json; registered count_report.json design_moves_seam: arrays equal)
inputs.inner_moves: data/prereg04/design_scratch/moves_inner.npz + moves_inner_moves.npy, re-indexed to results/prereg02/rank/dumps/inner_keys.npz row order by (rank, game_id); player_id and colour must agree

cells.base: O4 cell of tools/p04_opp.cells_of, unchanged: ((((pat*8+tac)*7+d_opp)*3+d_own)*3+phase), 557,928 cells
cells.line4: line = min(r, c, 18-r, 18-c) + 1 of the empty point; line4 = 0 for line 1-2, 1 for line 3, 2 for line 4, 3 for line >= 5
cells.lib3: approximate liberties of the mover's own block after playing the empty point = (number of empty on-board 4-neighbours) + sum over the DISTINCT own blocks adjacent to the point of (that block's liberties - 1); captures are ignored (they are in tac); lib3 = 0 for <= 1, 1 for 2, 2 for >= 3
cells.empty_points: recomputed with the same np.nonzero(board == 0) as cells_of (asserted identical order); own blocks recomputed with scipy.ndimage.label (4-connectivity) and the liberties with p04_opp._libs4
cells.counted_side: opponent moves only (C_o, A_o); level = the TARGET player's level; one int32 N_both accumulator pair per worker; every other table is an integer marginal sum of N_both

V0.cells: O4 cell (N_both summed over line4 and lib3)

V3.rate: r_k(x) = (C_k(x) + 20) / (A_k(x) + 20 / (r(x) * r_k^V0(cell(x)) / r^V0(cell(x)))), r(x) = (C(x) + 1) / (A(x) + 1 / r0) pooled over the levels on N_both, r^V0 the pooled V0 rate, r_k^V0 the V0 level-k rate

registered_formula: r0 = sum C / sum A; r(c) = (C(c) + 1) / (A(c) + 1 / r0); r_k(c) = (C_k(c) + 20) / (A_k(c) + 20 / r(c)); per opponent move log P_k = log r_k(played cell) - log sum_{empty q} r_k(cell(q)); per game: per phase sums, then summed over the 3 phases -> 10-vector
fusion: lp['Vi'] = log_softmax(o_Vi); u1_lib.run_gen(d, ['OP', 'Vi', 'SWA', 'SWB']) i.e. Q02 with O4 replaced by Vi (the task text writes ['Vi','SWA','SWB'] and 'replace O4 in Q02 by Vi'; Q02's terms are OP, O4, SWA, SWB, so OP is kept); 5-fold OOF, rule B, parameters fitted only on the other folds' fit questions

seams_stop_on_failure.a: first 300 subsample games: tools/p04_opp._count_shard (O4 cells, opponent side) == N_both marginal summed over line4 and lib3, cell by cell (C_o and A_o)
seams_stop_on_failure.b: slow per-point reference (p04_opp.ref_cell for the base cell + BFS liberties and line for the new parts) on >= 50 positions: 0 mismatches
seams_stop_on_failure.c: u1_lib.run_gen(d, ['OP','O4','SWA','SWB']) reproduces Q02 0.6101211982700248 (eval) and 0.6106683012815998 (single colour) within 1e-12
seams_stop_on_failure.extra: the replay also gathers the registered O4 opponent table (data/prereg04/counts_fit.npz via p04_opp.build_tables) and must equal results/prereg04/opp/inner_o4.npz 'o4' on every inner game within 1e-12 (checks the inner move alignment and the scoring path)

comparisons.primary: Vi - V0 (i = 1..3; both 25 % data, only the cells differ)
also: Vi - Q02 (i = 0..3; Q02's O4 uses 100 % of the fit data: conservative for the new cells)
V0 - Q02 = the loss from 100 % -> 25 % data (a data-size point for B4)
comparisons.items: rank-balanced mean difference on the 127,200 inner eval questions; paired PlayerBootstrap 95 % CI (decision; players within each level, 1,000 draws, default_rng(0)); qboot 95 % CI (record only; questions within each level, 2,000 draws, default_rng(0)); per-question mean difference; 10 levels; n bins 5-7 / 8-12 / 13-20; single-colour pseudo-questions (120,544): all / black / white via p03_rank_fuse.mono_diff_record and k = 5 / 10 / 15 / 20; official-shape weighted (single colour, each level 1/10, each k 1/4) with a paired PlayerBootstrap CI; p03_rank_fuse.se_val_record; per-game top-1 accuracy of each o_Vi on the 73,556 inner games (record only)

success_signal_fixed_before_running.enter_full_confirmation: any Vi (i = 1..3) with (Vi - V0) >= +0.005, PlayerBootstrap 95 % lower bound > 0, and single-colour black and white differences both > 0
success_signal_fixed_before_running.full_confirmation: recount N_both on 100 % of fit (2-3 player-hash parts, each run < 60 min, summed); full (Vi - Q02) >= +0.008, lower bound > 0, single-colour black and white > 0 -> write PREREG_05
success_signal_fixed_before_running.direct_pass: if the 25 % (Vi - Q02) is already >= +0.008 with lower bound > 0
